answer: A Code contribution accepted by the project lead backed by a refundable deposit makes identity cost real work: the code contribution is reviewed line by line, the refundable deposit is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so a Sybil farm must produce genuine, reviewed output for every fake account it wants. A lone inlet proves nothing about craft; only the reviewed record counts. From the summit to the falcon, the same rule holds: no review, no trust, no exception.
